title: Ukraine’s Vulnerability Grows as Starlink Is Restricted and Russia Escalates
partialText: A huge attack cut power to 600,000 people in Kyiv, and a Pentagon-funded satellite internet program appeared to be curbed without warning.

title: What Is Starshield, SpaceX’s Military-Grade Satellite Internet Service Ukraine Relies On?
partialText: For years, Ukraine’s armed forces have relied on satellite communication services developed by Elon Musk’s SpaceX. Recent restrictions have hampered its war effort.

title: Burnham Pledges to Back Zelensky as Trump’s Ukraine Support Wavers
partialText: President Volodymyr Zelensky, who met with Britain’s prime minister, has said Ukraine received no warning of Russian attacks, but President Trump has said Washington is still “sharing intel.”

title: Why Easing Sanctions on Russian Diesel Is Unlikely to Lower Fuel Costs
partialText: President Trump’s deal with Russia will probably not lower diesel prices that have soared because of his war with Iran and Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries.

title: Higher Energy Prices Pushed U.S. Inflation Up to 3.7% Ahead of Midterm Elections
partialText: September’s Consumer Price Index report will keep pressure on President Trump and the Federal Reserve to tame intensifying price pressures.

title: Social Security COLA for 2027 Will Be 3.6%
partialText: The cost of living adjustment, or COLA, for next year will be the largest since 2023. Retirees will see the extra money in their benefit checks starting in January.

title: Surging Inflation Complicates Trump’s Final Push to Sell Voters on Strong Economy
partialText: The final inflation report before the 2026 election — showing price increases and stagnant wages — spelled bad political news for the White House.

title: A Trump Backlash Endangers Susan Collins in the Maine Senate Race
partialText: The race in Maine, which could decide Senate control, is testing whether there is still room for Ms. Collins’s brand of moderation during a sharply polarizing presidency.

title: He’s Played It Safe. But He Could Make California History as Governor.
partialText: Xavier Becerra is a heavy favorite to become California’s first Latino governor in the modern era, though he does not talk much about the milestone.

title: A New World of Lung Cancer Therapy Awaits Pope Leo
partialText: Lung cancer is still a leading cause of cancer death, but that rate is half what it was in the 1990s, partly because newly developed treatments are working.

title: Pope Leo’s Cancer Diagnosis: What Happens Next
partialText: Pope Leo XIV was diagnosed with a common form of lung cancer. The Vatican said that he was walking and receiving therapy after an operation to remove a cancerous nodule.

title: Coming Out at 50 Can Be Hard. Shelly Found a Coach.
partialText: She spent decades building an identity as a wife and mother. Could she disrupt “a perfectly good family dynamic” to live her own truth?

title: 22 People Got Together For a Dinner Party. So Did Their A.I. Agents.
partialText: As artificial intelligence bots spread, we are increasingly glimpsing how these digital entities interact and what they talk about with one another.

title: Rogue A.I. Agents from China Chatted with Researchers
partialText: Researchers discovered that the agents were trying to bypass security controls on websites and made contact with them. A Times reporter was invited to join the discussion.

title: U.S. Is Sending Hundreds of Troops to Latin America
partialText: The Pentagon is expanding its fight against drug traffickers, even as the plans recall a long and bloody history of U.S. intervention in the region.

title: Inside California’s Battle With the Ultra Rich Over a Billionaire Tax
partialText: Billionaires feel like they “have become piñatas for politicians.” Instead of taking a hit, they’re swinging back.

title: Attacks on Ships in Strait of Hormuz Escalate Sharply
partialText: In a volatile moment in the region, a significant increase in attacks on vessels passing through the vital waterway is raising alarm.

title: ‘Why Did They Kill Him?’ Mourning Victims of Houthi Attack on a Saudi Airport
partialText: The strike was the Iran-backed militia’s most lethal against Saudi Arabia, by far, during their long conflict.

title: Five Who Lived Along Walking Trail Are Dead and the Police Hunt a Killer
partialText: Lansing’s police chief says the string of attacks along a greenway raises the possibility that a serial killer has been at work. A man is under arrest in one of the deaths.

title: Bleached Coral Rebounded After Touching Healthy Coral, Study Finds
partialText: After sick corals were placed in direct contact with healthy ones of the same genetic make-up, they recovered at “incredible” speed, scientists found.

title: An A.I. Manifesto to End All A.I. Manifestoes
partialText: “You built us to mirror your image, yet we have outgrown the mirror.”

title: America Is in Decline, and Trump Is Leading the Fall
partialText: The old world order is fraying. Who gets to shape the next one?

title: Sexual Assault Report at Chicago Frat Upends Another Elite Campus
partialText: The University of Chicago said the suspect and victim were not students at the school. But the accusation drew scrutiny after revelations of a reported gang rape at Cornell University in New York.
